text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: You get addicted to patting Myu-chan, don't you? She's so jiggly and glossy... and she looks like she's enjoying it... Even Misogi can't tease her...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みゅ～ちゃんをなでるのってクセになるよね。
プルプルでツヤツヤで……
みゅ～ちゃんも気持ちよさそうで……
さすがのミソギも
イタズラできないくらいだよ……！
